mapper.sql: select id, uid, type, scene, symbol, ymd, balance, frozen,publiced,refunded,refund_at , relate_id, relate_memo, clear_day, begin_balance, begin_frozen, memo, create_at, create_time from a_asset_flow

select a.id, a.uid, a.type, a.scene, a.symbol, a.ymd, a.balance, a.frozen, a.publiced, a.refunded, a.refund_at , a.relate_id, a.relate_memo, a.clear_day, a.begin_balance, a.begin_frozen, a.memo, a.create_at, a.create_time, l.account, b.pid from a_asset_flow a left join u_login l on l.uid = a.uid and l.type = 3
mapper.insert:
insert into a_asset_flow
uid, scene, symbol, ymd, balance, frozen, relate_id, relate_memo, clear_day, begin_balance, begin_frozen, memo, create_at, create_time,
#{uid}, #{scene}, #{symbol}, #{ymd}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{relateId}, #{relateMemo}, #{clearDay}, #{beginBalance}, #{beginFrozen}, #{memo}, #{createAt}, #{createTime},
mapper.delete:
delete from a_asset_flow where id in
#{id}
mapper.select:
select a.ymd, ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0101' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'sysRecharge', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0102' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'sysReduce', ifnull(sum(case when a.scene = '0103' and a.refunded = 0 then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'withdraw', ifnull(sum(case when a.scene = '0103' and a.refunded = 1 then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'withdrawRefund', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0104' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'recharge', ifnull(sum(case when a.scene = '0201' and a.refunded = 0 then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'pay', ifnull(sum(case when a.scene = '0201' and a.refunded = 1 then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'payRefund', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0301' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'invest', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0401' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'statics', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0402' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'teamInvite', ifnull(sum(case a.scene when '0503' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'publicRank', ifnull(sum(case when a.scene = '0601' and a.symbol = 'USDT' then a.balance else 0 end),0) 'exchange' from a_asset_flow a, ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( select 0 as n, u.* from u_member u join u_login ul on u.id = ul.uid and ul.type in (3)
and u.id = #{uid} and ul.account = #{account} and u.deleted = 0
union all select n+1,e.* from u_member e inner join `cte` c on e.pid = c.id and e.deleted = 0 ) select distinct id, pid, n from `cte` ) b
and a.uid = b.id and a.ymd between #{params.beginDay} and #{params.endDay}
group by a.ymd order by a.ymd desc

and u.id = #{uid} and ul.account = #{account} and u.deleted = 0
union all select n+1,e.* from u_member e inner join `cte` c on c.pid = e.id and e.deleted =0 ) select distinct id, pid, n from `cte` ) b
